開かれた扉からは足音が二つ。

Wind enters the damp, sealed chamber.

Two sets of footsteps sound beyond the open door.

One strikes the floor in a hurried rhythm. The other belongs to someone being led along, all but dragged.

彼の祖父である間桐臓硯が飼っている、得体の知れない魔物どもによるものだ。

pages.en:
Trails remain upon the chamber floor where something writhed and dragged itself along.

Shinji Matou knows what left them.

They belong to the incomprehensible monsters kept by his grandfather, Zouken Matou.

These are lust worms that his grandfather, Matou Zouken, raises that love human blood, semen, and marrow.

「ほら。イヤなコトは早くすまそう」
階段の上から語りかける。
魔物たちの気配が充満した密室。常人ではこの部屋に踏み入れた瞬間、恐怖に支配されることだろう。

He speaks from the top of the stairs.

The sealed chamber is saturated with the presence of monsters. Any ordinary person would succumb to terror the instant they crossed its threshold.

ただその周囲で、ざわざわと気配を震わせるだけである。
